_what: House rules for the table you actually play at. Everything in the engine and the playbook should read from here, never from constants.

rules._note: deep-merged over engine/src/rules.ts DEFAULT_RULES; confirmed with the player 2026-08-23

bao._colour_note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-01: it is the THIRD meld that is bao - two melds of one suit down, you throw that suit and they claim it, you kena bao. Attaches at the feed, so it holds even if they then self-draw. If somebody else later feeds a bao tile, the bao transfers to them.
bao._terminal_note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-01: all-pong counts only when the pongs are honours, dragons and 1s/9s - a plain all-pong of middle numbers is not bao. Third such meld is the bao, same as colour.
bao._wind_note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-01: winds stay at the FOURTH pong, unlike dragons/colour/terminals which are the third.
bao._kong_note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-01: they kong your discard, draw the replacement and win on it - you are bao. Does not persist: once they discard, the replacement is spent and the liability with it.

jokers._stranded_note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-01: four melds down and nothing but wildcards in hand - cannot win (0 tai, under the minimum) and cannot throw. The player kena bao and pays every other player the maximum, $42 each.

money._note: the "3/6, shooter pay, ZM +$2" table, SGD. Mode = SHOOTER PAYS: the discarder alone pays the whole shoot_total (5 tai = $40, which is 20+10+10 of shares). The "everyone pays" alternative splits it 20/10/10 across the three losers.

confirmed_2026_09_01.self_draw_bonus_fan: NO. There is no +1 tai for a self-draw. The 1-tai minimum exemption is the whole of it, and event_scoring has no self-draw entry, so the engine already matches.
confirmed_2026_09_01.wind_bao: the FOURTH wind pong, not the third. Everything else (dragons, colour, terminals) is the third.
confirmed_2026_09_01.kong_feed_bao: feeding a kong that wins on its replacement makes you bao, and the hand scores +1 tai for the replacement win (event_scoring.replacement_win = 1, already matches).
confirmed_2026_09_01.three_wildcards: worth nothing. Only all four score, at 5 tai. Two and three add no tai. Engine already matches - score.ts only lifts the hand at jokers >= 4.
confirmed_2026_09_01.flower_animal_honour_scoring: ALL CONFIRMED as the engine already had them. Own flower 1 and own season 1 (hold both and that is 2 tai); all four flowers +1, all four seasons +1; each animal 1, all four animals +1; dragon pong 1, seat wind 1, round wind 1 (a pong of the wind that is both scores both, so 2). Seven bonus tiles is 10 tai flat and replaces the individual flower tai; eight is an instant win.
confirmed_2026_09_01.combination_tai_top5: The five hand types that decide 99.5% of wins, all CONFIRMED as the engine already had them: ping_hu 4, chou_ping_hu 1, peng_peng_hu 2, ban_se 2, and chicken scoring nothing from its pattern. peng_peng_hu is no longer an inference. The engine separates ping_hu from chou_ping_hu by FLOWERS - an all-chow hand holding no flower or animal is ping_hu at 4, and any bonus tile drops it to chou_ping_hu at 1.

unconfirmed.combination_tai_rest: The top 5 are confirmed above and cover 99.5% of wins. The remaining ~20 values are still engine defaults, but every one of them occurs in under 0.3% of hands: qing_yi_se 4, xiao_san_yuan 3, and a long list of 5-tai limit hands. Low priority.
unconfirmed.dead_config_two_dragons_eye_three_winds_: honour_scoring.two_dragons_eye (1) and three_winds_eye (4) are declared in rules.ts and NEVER READ by the scorer. Setting them does nothing. xiao_san_yuan and xiao_si_xi appear to cover the same hands. Delete them or wire them - do not leave them looking live.
unconfirmed.dealer_rules: never asked: dealer keeps the deal on a win (true), keeps it on a draw (true), 4 hands per wind.

confirmed_2026_08_29.joker_assumptions: a wildcard cannot be thrown at all (discardable false), so claimable_when_discarded never arises; jokers cannot be used in exposed pongs/chows/kongs; jokers score as the tiles they stand for; all-joker groups take no honour value
